Harvest Lentil Loaf

From the Pantry Cookbook

  • 2 cups cooked lentils
  • 1 cup rolled oats
  • 1 large onion, chopped
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • Mustard Glaze (see recipe)

Heat the oven to 375 degrees and oil a loaf pan.

Mash the lentils with the oats and onion, press into the pan and bake for 40 minutes. Serve with the Mustard Glaze.

Mustard Glaze

  • 1/2 cup ketchup
  • 2 tablespoons brown mustard
  • 1 tablespoon maple syrup

Whisk the ketchup, mustard and maple syrup in a small saucepan.

Simmer for 5 minutes and spoon the warm glaze over the loaf.
